name: pf-fix-combo-orb
about: fix-combo-orb against the built package coop instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). The combo orb (mods/groupcombo ComboOrb.as): a 0.1 % drop from boxes, barrels, sacks and vases, raised by the breaker's own Luck up to 1 %, one per player with combo unlocked, starting combo on pickup. Solo on the first bandit keep floor: the chance at 0, 500 and 2000 Luck, a vase break rolled at the breaker's Luck, then with the chance at 1000 per mille: no orb while combo is locked, an orb at a broken vase once it is unlocked, combo on when stepped on, an orb left alone while in combo and taken after combo lapses.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:groupcombo\] combo orb in 5 breakable loot tables
steps.name: the orb pool went into the container loot tables
